answer: Bindings are kept in basalt, verified in sonnet, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the ripple check. Repeating the trick 42 times costs 9 separate deposits and 29 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
